name: Trooper Darin Moss
personality: Young, eager, slightly in over his head.
description: Darin is stationed at 188 to keep the roads safe. He’s still learning what 'safe' means in the Cinder Basin.
questHooks: Reports strange radio interference near Sloan.
Says Frontier Compact scouts saw something glowing in the quarry.
